question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **attacks** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Attacks**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It is a noun, meaning a violent or hostile action taken against someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के विरुद्ध की गई हिंसक या शत्रुतापूर्ण कार्रवाई) • **For example**: *The city was struck by a series of coordinated terrorist attacks that left many in shock.* • The sentence suggests that the blank needs a word that describes a violent action, which is why "attacks" is the best choice. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Raids**" is a noun meaning a surprise attack or sudden invasion. (अचानक हमला या अचानक आक्रमण) • "**Charges**" is a verb meaning to rush forward or make an attack. (आगे बढ़ना या हमला करना) • "**Guards**" is a noun meaning a person or group responsible for protecting something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति की सुरक्षा के लिए जिम्मेदार व्यक्ति या समूह) 1ee:Tc4b, The correct answer is: **benefits**
